name: adze-android
description: Drive Android emulators through accessibility from the command line: read the accessibility tree, tap, type and swipe through UiAutomation.
author: Alex Hall <me@jalexhall.com>

scripts.build:server: cd server && ./gradlew --no-daemon -q assembleDebug && mkdir -p ../apk && cp build/outputs/apk/debug/adze-server-debug.apk ../apk/adze-server.apk && cp build/outputs/adze-server.version ../apk/adze-server.version
